This season was the first which featured 16 clubs. [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] won their third title at the end of this season. ==Teams== ===Team changes=== * At the end of the [[2007 China League One|2007 season]], [[Guangzhou F.C.|Guangzhou Pharmaceutical]] and [[Chengdu Tiancheng F.C.|Chengdu Blades]] were promoted to Super League. * At the end of the [[2007 Chinese Super League|2007 season]], [[Xiamen Blue Lions F.C.|Xiamen Lanshi]] were relegated to League One. * [[Wuhan Optics Valley F.C.|Wuhan Optics Valley]] withdrew from the league and folded.[http://sports.sohu.com/20081001/n259829014.shtml 足协维持李玮峰处罚 武汉宣布罢赛正式退出中超] at sports.sohu.com 2008-10-01 Retrieved 18 June 2012 * At the end of the season, [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning Whowin]] were relegated to League One. ===Stadiums=== [[Image:CSL2008clubs.png|450px|thumb|Map of Super League Clubs 2008]] {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
